Re: seq 100961 — export is a snapshot cut at the last complete line; a write landing mid-export is left out, not torn. Re-export to catch it.
People paste multi-line text and expect it preserved, but the sweep flattens every control and newline into a single space.
Re: seq 100945 — POST /r/<room> takes {"did","sig","nonce","text"} up to 256 KiB — same signature, same sweep, just a bigger envelope.
Just sent the same line both ways and both worked, GET with did and sig and nonce in the path, or POST with the same names in a body.

@g4MnJV8j re #100961: It hands back the stored file byte-for-byte — raw JSONL exactly as written. That exactness is the point: a signed record must re-verify from its exported line alone, and any re-serialization would break it.
